text:
Hello! I'm Diego, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer.

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX**: I can have my own accounts, so you can write and call me there — same for Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **Own accounts online**: I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
On it — I'm asking the CSE455 TAs for their free windows next week so I can put the staff meeting in a free slot and confirm it.
Done: CSE455 staff meeting set for **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** next week — the only slot free for all seven TAs and for me. Booked on my calendar and logged; the TAs have been told to add it.
